public_rationale: On September 29, 2026, Zitron wrote that Anthropic had a net loss of $42 billion in 2025, citing figures from its S-1. The S-1, filed on October 26, 2026, reports a net loss of $41,965 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, in audited statements prepared under U.S. GAAP. That is $41.965 billion, which rounds to $42 billion.
limitations: This record does not assess his description of the loss as stock-related and not a cash loss.
Zitron's source was a Reuters report on a leaked draft. The record checks his figure against the S-1 as filed.
